gaps.summary: Protected developer routes expose Authorization as an optional header parameter and define no BearerAuth security scheme.
POST /v1/batches accepts an arbitrary JSON object in OpenAPI.
GET /v1/batches has no after cursor and no typed page metadata.
GET file content is documented as an empty application/json response instead of application/jsonl bytes.
The public Files list and delete operations are not implemented.
POST /v1/files documents purpose as a query parameter rather than a multipart form field.
Files and Batches operations expose empty successful response schemas.
The default OpenAPI document mixes developer APIs with auth, admin, health, metrics, and reporting routes.
Public request validation is documented with FastAPI's 422 HTTPValidationError rather than a stable dialect-aware 400 envelope.
